description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to MCP health monitoring and UI representation, including classes for MCP summaries, agent node details, server health, and functions for transforming health data based on display mode.

classes.name: MCPSummaryForUI
classes.description: Represents MCP health summary optimized for UI display, including server counts, health metrics, and service status.

classes.name: AgentNodeDetailsForUI
classes.description: Contains detailed agent node information including MCP data, with fields for ID, team, version, health, heartbeat, registration, and MCP server details.

classes.name: MCPServerHealthForUI
classes.description: Represents MCP server health data tailored for UI, including status, tool count, uptime, error messages, and UI-specific display fields.

classes.name: CachedMCPHealth
classes.description: Stores cached MCP health data with timestamp and node ID.

classes.name: MCPHealthResponseData
classes.description: Raw MCP health data received from agent, including server list and summary.

classes.name: MCPServerHealthData
classes.description: Raw data for individual MCP server health status.

classes.name: MCPSummaryData
classes.description: Raw summary data for MCP health, including server counts and overall health.

methods.name: TransformMCPHealthForMode
methods.description: Transforms raw MCP health data into UI-friendly summary and server list based on display mode (user or developer).

methods.name: getStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns icon name based on server status for UI display.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns color code based on server status for UI display.

methods.name: formatUptime
methods.description: Formats server uptime duration into human-readable string.
